verdict.rationale: Working Copy offers built-in event-driven automation via Auto-Sync (auto-commit/pull/push on detected changes) and Background Sync, plus integration with the Shortcuts app so files/data can flow between actions triggered by iOS automations. This covers a narrow set of built-in triggers but there's no evidence of a general rule engine (e.g., custom conditions, webhooks, arbitrary event-to-action mapping) beyond these fixed sync behaviors and Shortcuts glue. Missing for 10: user-definable conditional rules beyond sync toggles, webhook/event triggers, documented examples of Shortcuts-based automation recipes, and independent confirmation of reliability.
